acceptance.description: test clock tick at 08:00 starts one scheduled run, one runs row with counts, no second run same day
overlapping triggers give one runs row (also scheduler tick overlap in test_p5_scheduler.py, busy stage POST in surfaces)
scheduled run with applying off never calls the apply stage callable (also test_p5_runs.py apply gating)
discovery over three companies stores all fields; rediscovery keeps one record and updates last-seen
failing source logged against its name in the run log; other sources still stored
add/remove company changes what next run searches; company CLI messages
schedule, scheduler, export --help exit 0; top-level help lists new commands
blocked tickets enter the queue once each with company, reason, page link
/runs page contains each run's counts, empty state, /api/runs, index tab and buttons
several missed slots start exactly one run; README documents missed-run catch-up
scheduled apply limit is per-day limit minus today's submissions; skipped when reached
each stage runs alone via run_stage/start_stage_async, no runs row (also CLI busy and POST stage in surfaces)
schedule set/get/clear, parse_time rejects invalid values (also schedule CLI in surfaces)
export writes tickets.csv and runs.csv with headers and rows; bad directory raises
--help exits 0 for existing commands on a fresh install (unchanged behaviour)

untestable.reason: tests assert the injected apply stage is never invoked in a scheduled run; the verifier checks by reading code that only the apply stage reaches the browser launcher
